## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve. For example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Be as specific as possible about the behavior, commands, or UI changes you envision.

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and why they might not be sufficient.

## Target Audience

Who would benefit from this feature? [e.g., all users, users of a specific tool importer, dashboard users]

## Example Usage

If applicable, provide an example of how this feature would be used:

```powershell
# Example command or workflow
```

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or references about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have checked the existing [issues](https://github.com/maliktafheem/coding-effectiveness-tracker/issues) and this is not a duplicate.
- [ ] I have checked the [documentation](https://github.com/maliktafheem/coding-effectiveness-tracker/tree/master/docs) and this feature is not already documented.
- [ ] I understand this is a local-first tool and features requiring cloud infrastructure may be out of scope.
